mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_ai_todo_event (thread_id, eval_id, ticket_id, assignment_id, round_id, call_id, kind, status, summary, detail, duration_ms, event_time, add_time, update_time) VALUES (#{threadId}, #{evalId}, #{ticketId}, #{assignmentId}, #{roundId}, #{callId}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{summary}, #{detail}, #{durationMs}, #{eventTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT th.id AS threadId, t.id AS ticketId, a.id AS assignmentId, t.title, a.state, a.report_state AS reportState, a.report_summary AS reportSummary, a.started_time AS startedTime, a.idle_time AS idleTime, a.delivered_time AS deliveredTime, e.event_time AS lastEventTime, e.kind AS lastKind, e.status AS lastStatus, e.summary AS lastSummary FROM xxl_ai_todo_assignment a JOIN xxl_ai_todo_ticket t ON t.id = a.ticket_id JOIN xxl_ai_todo_thread th ON th.id = t.thread_id LEFT JOIN xxl_ai_todo_event e ON e.id = ( SELECT MAX(ev.id) FROM xxl_ai_todo_event ev WHERE ev.assignment_id = a.id ) WHERE th.user_id = #{userId} AND t.ended_time IS NULL AND a.state IN ('pending', 'running') ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 100
